mechanism_narrative: The four-week improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility reflects a steady return of commuting and errand trips; this commuting recovery directly raises weekday retail-and-recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days will be higher than its last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -69.0 at t-3w to -39.9 at t-0w
fact:WORKPLACES rose from -64.0 at t-3w to -40.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both continue to improve week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GROCERY_PHARM above -10 percent signals that essential-travel restrictions have eased enough to normalize grocery trips; this frees household travel capacity for discretionary retail and recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not exceed its last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -10.0 percent.
